name: TCG 2010 (Edison era, Master Rule 1 baseline)
description: The closest EDOPro preset for March-2010 TCG play: the DUEL_MODE_MR1 composite (pre-March-2011 mechanics: ignition priority, first-turn draw, single face-up Field Spell, old negation/oath counting, deck-return triggers). Synchro Monsters are legal; Xyz/Pendulum/Link do not exist yet.

era.official_ruleset_label: 'Master Rule' era rulebook (the official label/date range for this rules era still needs a sourced citation; EDOPro calls the preset 'Master Rule 1')

differences_from_modern.summary: The turn player may activate ignition effects with priority after a summon or chain end (OCG-style condition in the MR1 composite).
The turn-1 player draws in their first Draw Phase.
Only one Field Spell can be face-up at a time.
A negated Special Summon still counts against 'only once per turn/duel' summon restrictions.

known_gaps.summary: The MR1 composite uses the OCG-style ignition-priority condition; ocgcore also has the broader DUEL_TCG_FAST_EFFECT_IGNITION and the TCG SEGOC flags (used by the GOAT composite). Whether 2010 TCG play requires those TCG variants instead is unresearched — a sourced ruling comparison should decide, and this profile updated to a custom flag set if so.
Extra Deck size limit for 2010 (15) is entered here from the EDOPro MR1 preset defaults, not yet from a period rulebook citation.

notes: Named -edison to leave room for splitting the long 'MR1' span into finer sourced eras later; nothing in it is Edison-specific today.
